outcome.technical: tools/prove-gates.py: (MED-A) close_workers and reap_stale no longer run `git worktree prune`; a pool tree is removed by `worktree remove --force --force`, and when git refuses on a missing directory, by `_drop_registration`, which deletes only the admin dir whose gitdir names that tree and refuses any path outside the pool root. reap_stale only considers trees named `w<N>` under a `prove-gates-pool-` root (`_pool_tree`). (MED-B) reap_stale reaps only on `alive(pid) is False`; the default probe is `_pid_state` (`_locks.pid_alive`, three-valued) instead of `_suite.pid_alive`, which folds unknown into dead; a pool whose root is gone altogether is reaped (no owner left, no run can use it). (R45) `redfirst_call(rel, old, new, suite, tree, scratch, base)` is the pure argv/cwd/env; prove(row, repo, run=None, base=None) has no default tree (raises ValueError without one) and takes an injectable runner; pw8 pins cwd, argv incl. --allow-dirty, CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/PWD repoint, git location vars dropped, temp roots, and the pre/post byte backstop. (R48) _mirror applies with `--index`; the fixture gains a staged-new n.txt and pw3 asserts it is in each worker's index. (low 1) `__main__` installs a SIGTERM handler `_exit_on_term` raising SystemExit(128+signum) so main's finally closes the pool (pw12). (low 2) run_ordered cancels not-started futures on any exception/interrupt (pw9). (low 3) _mirror returns `(problem, skipped)`; open_workers keeps `skipped`, main says each on stderr (pw10). (low 4) main returns 2 when reap_stale raises; reap_stale raises RuntimeError when `git worktree list` fails (pw11). pw13 pins the gone-root reap and the by-name removal.
